name: GT4SD/molecular-design
what_it_is: A seven-step computational pipeline for target-based drug discovery chaining generative deep learning models (MoLeR, Regression Transformer) with virtual screening (ToxSmi) and retrosynthesis (IBM RXN) to produce synthesizable candidate molecules.
constraints: IBM RXN requires account and API key
MoLeR quality depends on seed file
Pipeline sequential with hard-coded intermediate paths
Conda dependency conflict requires reinstall workaround
notable_absences: No web UI or REST API
